basic_info.description: Charming original-condition home in the heart of the Outer Sunset, perfectly situated on a great block just blocks from Noriega Street shops, restaurants, and the beach. This classic tunnel entrance residence features beautiful parquet wood floors, a spacious living room with elegant coved doorways, period moldings, and a cozy fireplace, and a formal dining room. The bright eat-in kitchen and spacious bathroom with separate tub and shower offer a perfect canvas for your vision, while two generous rear bedrooms overlook the deep backyard. A full basement includes laundry & a bonus room, and presents exciting expansion potential. The deep lot (120 ft) features a rear patio and expansive yardideal for gardening or outdoor living. A rare opportunity to customize a timeless San Francisco home in an unbeatable location.
